book.name: Roma
book.title: Roma Roma Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: Gavana azaḡaniꞌa vaze ibitoziꞌeteꞌe inaraḡa meiro. Vaze niduꞌa zeḡe ḡoere egoziniꞌuma. Mazaḡa Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo mene ariroteꞌe inaraḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa. Izidi gavana azaḡa inara zuni Badiꞌaꞌa zeḡe rana tiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo iniu gavana azaḡa agiroziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa agirohauꞌeteꞌe heuḡa, ebu ꞌouge haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe kotaziꞌuma.

Manoḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe vaze ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mene rihozeꞌohe, rehano sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ze rihozeꞌohe. Za gavana vazeḡa mene rihonihi raꞌehe? Tena haḡai manoḡa haḡaoꞌi, ꞌougine aniꞌa za niguziꞌuma.

Gavana vazeḡaꞌe zae manoḡa veize Badiꞌaꞌa ohoniroteꞌe tuḡureḡa vazeḡa. Rehano zaeꞌa veꞌoḡa haḡaoꞌidene ani rihonoꞌi, mazaḡa ane benisiꞌe mene rohoroho. Aniꞌe Badiꞌa tuḡure vazeḡa radu sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa mazao Badiꞌa zama ḡugiꞌa hina aduga hauꞌohe.
Eꞌanoꞌo zaꞌe gavana azaḡa egoziniꞌuma. Aꞌe aduga hidoga rihoneꞌeteꞌe uꞌano mene ꞌougiꞌuma, rehano za zaeꞌa bare ḡoereze egoziniꞌetaꞌaꞌe duduḡa rae zamareꞌeteꞌe uꞌano egoziniꞌuma.
Eꞌe uꞌano, za takesi zuni ziniꞌohe. Gavana azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌa tuḡure azaḡa radu deꞌe gauḡa veize inareꞌohe.
Vaze niduꞌa mazao nagini ziniteꞌe ḡauḡaꞌe zenoꞌi. Takesi nunu ziniꞌuma rae roꞌidene, takesi nunu zini hunoꞌi. Ebu iniu zaꞌa rihoziteꞌe azaḡaꞌe rihozoꞌi zu iniu gubaziteꞌe azaḡaꞌe gubazoꞌi.

Iniu mazaonoꞌo hadi nu moꞌidene, niduꞌa barone hunoꞌi. Rehano zaꞌa ꞌaune baronoziniteꞌe ḡauḡa ꞌahogaꞌe zamarotiteꞌeteꞌe raꞌohe. Vaze zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa niduꞌa hube hune hegote huniroteꞌe heuḡa.

Goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe ꞌahige raꞌohe, “Ubuma ago ḡezanoꞌi, ago gorugoroꞌi, ago ḡonotanoꞌi zu vaze ḡau meihi rae ago zamaroꞌi.” Ebu goro ḡoeꞌa nunu zuni eꞌe rehano, goro ḡoeꞌa niduꞌaꞌe goro ḡoeꞌa tiba ꞌahi zamaḡano eꞌe, “Ḡa ḡae bare zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe teige, ḡae nego nabudi zamare borofoꞌi.”
Vaze zamareꞌetaꞌaꞌe nego nabudi mazao sauꞌa mene haḡaeꞌeteꞌe raꞌohe. Eꞌanoꞌo vaze zamare borofeꞌetaꞌaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa niduꞌa hube hune hegote huneꞌeteꞌe heuḡa.
Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa Bare Onaiteꞌe Madaḡaniꞌa Haniteha

Za ꞌouge haḡae radoꞌi, mazaḡa izidiꞌe noꞌe madaḡaꞌe zaꞌe edeḡa. Zaeꞌa bazunionoꞌo evatiteꞌe madaḡaꞌe amahi ariro, mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa ḡabofiteꞌe madaḡaꞌe haniteha. Eꞌe madaḡaꞌe emeꞌa fieꞌeteꞌe ḡadahiroteꞌe madaḡa zuni haniteha, rehano izidiꞌe ufeta haniteha.
Ohereꞌe nariga hauḡeꞌohe ebu agaḡa madaḡaꞌe haniteha. Eꞌanoꞌo eme uzabo haḡaiḡa dabuaḡa fuhiꞌe modihi ebu uti dabuaḡa agaḡa mae vidatihi.

Emeꞌe agaḡa zamaḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa, eꞌanoꞌo haḡai duduḡa haḡaiꞌuma. Mui matuꞌuḡa mene ufeta vaḡiꞌuma zu mene ufeta gage tauḡitauḡiꞌuma. Ubuma mene ḡezaꞌuma zu daro mene futaꞌuma. Mene rotetiꞌuma zu mene ahiahiꞌuma.
Rehano dabua vidauꞌeteꞌe teige, Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Keriso hina zaeꞌa bare vidozenoꞌi. Haḡai sauꞌa haḡaihi rae raꞌeteꞌe zamaroneḡa veize ahiri ura haḡaiḡa ago haḡaoꞌi.
